turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My cat is a bit of a round boy. The vet said lose a kilo. How?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Slowly is the key, cats shouldn't lose weight too fast. Ask the vet for his exact daily food amount and weigh it out with kitchen scales.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He screams if his bowl's empty.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Split the daily amount into four or five small meals. More frequent meals feel like more food.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He gets a few. Okay, a lot.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Take treats out of his daily allowance, or swap to tiny bits of cooked chicken.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He also doesn't really move much.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Get him chasing a feather wand for a few minutes twice a day. Even lazy cats will hunt something if it's interesting.
